title: Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Apprentice (Multiple Trades)
qualification: DBT Note: An additional Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) amount of ₹4,000/month for Diploma Apprentices and ₹4,500/month for Graduate Apprentices is provided by the Government of India under the NATS scheme. The above stipend figures are inclusive of DBT wherever applicable. Candidates must have an active Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled bank account.
age_limit: Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years of age . Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories will be applicable as per Government of India guidelines.
